findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added on UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). There is no no-arg overload in this class or its parents, so this change does not compile and the passkeys re-authentication path cannot be built or tested.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys UI dropped on initial login
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns true only when the user is already non-null, and both authenticate() (line 115) and the error challenge() (line 137) use that check before fillContextForm(). Previously the WebAuthn conditional UI (challenge, rpId, ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI) was filled when no user was selected yet, which is the username-less/discoverable passkey login. Now the first username/password page and invalid-user error pages never set up passkeys, so conditional passkey login on a fresh authentication no longer works. The user != null requirement should not gate form setup; passkeys-enabled alone should.
